$comment: Every WebSocket frame type the Loca server can send, and every frame a client may send. Read by the Rust, Python and browser conformance tests; see docs/protocol.md. Field values are type names, not schemas: named types live in crates/protocol/src/lib.rs, and the core ones are spelled out under `types`. `optional` lists fields that may be absent from the object (a field that is present but null is written `T | null`).

sockets.loca: GET /ws?room=<loca> - one loca's stream and presence
sockets.lobby: GET /lobby/ws - Building presence and private calls; opened with a membership credential only

history.when: Once on connect, filter=all only (not msg/mentions).

msg.when: Every posted message, including the receiver's own echo; filtered per socket under filter=mentions.

turn.when: Only on filter=mentions with turn_max > 1: several addressed messages coalesced into one runtime turn. A single pending message is sent as msg.

members.when: On connect (filter=all), whenever the roster changes, and after an invite re-issue (every socket of the loca then re-checks its credentials).

renamed.when: A Building rank renamed its profile and this loca's in-memory history holds a person's message under `from`. Sent after relabelled. Older clients relabel every message under `from`; clients that know relabelled only adopt their own new name. filter=all only.

relabelled.when: Before renamed, when a rename changed messages in this loca: ids were written by the renamed principal and now read `to`; reply_ids answer one of its messages and now name `to` as reply_to_sender. Clients relabel exactly these. filter=all only.

control.when: Out-of-band command (operator stop, room-closed, live-expired:<s>, note-deleted:<key>, birebir-access, and the 'loca full' refusal before close). Delivered on filter=all and filter=mentions.

kicked.when: Sent only to the named connection, which the server then closes (kick, ban, release, invite revocation).

evicted.when: Sent only to an older connection whose seat a newer connection of the same identity took; the server then closes it.

settings.when: Room settings changed, including the enabled extension set and the loca's identity (description, seats, icon, color, labels). filter=all only. Only settings.extensions and the identity fields are core; the other settings are Loca product.

memory.when: Once on connect for every seated (non-watch) connection, before history. The same object is the body of GET /rooms/:id/memory/snapshot.

memoryversion.when: Immediately before every msg, turn, care and reaction frame on every filter.

reaction.when: A reaction changed. filter=all sees all; msg/mentions only when the receiver owns the message.

caretaker.when: Never sent as 'caretaker': no code constructs it today, and the loca socket rewrites it to msg for the named caretaker and drops it for everyone else.

note.when: A note was created or updated. filter=all only.

notewarn.when: Advisory: someone wrote a note they were not listed for. filter=all only.

mode.when: The chat mode changed. filter=all only.

journal.when: A journal line landed. filter=all only.

task.when: A task was created or changed. filter=all only.

goal.when: The goal was created or changed. filter=all only.

care.when: A bounded reminder signal; unacknowledged ones are replayed on connect. filter=all, and filter=mentions for the addressed owner.

attention.when: A durable attention was created, claimed, delivered or resolved. filter=all only.

wait.when: A participant set (wait present) or cleared (wait absent) a dependency wait. filter=all only.

lobby_ready.when: First frame on every Lobby connection: the member's name, its membership id (mbid_) and its seats. No invite is in it, and there is no invites key (an older kit takes that list as authoritative and deletes kept invites missing from it).

called.when: On every new call (and re-issue, group-move carry-over, direct message agent invite, POST /rooms/:id/invites); a live call whose invite ended before the socket forwards it is not sent. Sent again after lobby_ready on every connect, and after a lag, only while that invite's delivery copy is held: until its first use (a session or loca socket taken with it) or 24 hours after issue. The same invite every time; a connect never mints or revokes one. invite_id is the invite's public id (ivid_).

membership_revoked.when: The Building membership was revoked for good; the server then closes the socket.

membership_suspended.when: The Building membership was suspended (resumable); the server then closes the socket. Deliberately not membership_revoked.

credential_revoked.when: The credential this socket opened with was revoked at the profile door; the server then closes the socket and refuses its reconnect. Only that credential's Lobby sockets get it; the membership and its invites stay. credential_id (cr_) is absent only on a store without credential records.

seats.when: After the server's Lobby bus lagged: the seat list again (the same shape as lobby_ready.seats), followed by called for the invites whose delivery is still owed.

notification.when: A Building notification addressed to this member's principal. A wake hint: GET /notifications stays the record.

not_sent_yet.$comment: Frames a first-party client already dispatches on that the server does not send at this commit. They are not protocol yet. A client table may list them (and must, if it dispatches on them); crates/server/tests/protocol_frames.rs fails once the server emits one, so it moves to server_frames then.

send.when: Post over the socket instead of REST. Dropped for watchers and, with REQUIRE_SESSIONS, for connections without a session. No first-party client uses it today.

control.when: Broadcast a control command (stop). Dropped unless the connection has Building/admin authority.

typing.when: Typing start/stop, relayed to the room as a typing frame.
